title: Yogi Bear's Jellystone Park at Daddy Joe's

services.name: RV Sites
services.desc: Jellystone Park™ Tabor City, NC offers 176 RV sites each equipped with concrete pads (50x70) available to accommodate even the largest RV or tent with a tow vehicle. Each site has a fire ring with a cooking grate and picnic table to enjoy s'mores and the great outdoors. All RV sites have water, sewer, cable TV, and 20/30/50-amp electric connections. Pick from a pull thru site, back in site, wooded site, Golden Getaway, or Quad and enjoy RV camping at it's finest! Concrete Pad and Patio, Outdoor Kitchen: propane grill, sink, cooler, trash can, Polywood Picnic

services.name: Yurts
services.desc: Are you looking for a unique way to camp? Jellystone Park™ Tabor City has you covered. Our yurts are 16' around in diameter and offer you a true camping experience without sleeping outdoors. All of our yurts are equipped with heat/AC for your comfort. Each yurt has its own personal bathroom just steps away. Our yurts are pet friendly so be sure you bring your furry friend on your camping vacation. Yurt #4 is ADA and features a ramp to the front door as well as a ramp to the ADA Bathroom. There is also an ADA fire pit and picnic table at this yurt. When you pack for your vacation in a yurt remember to pack your towels, pillows, sheets, and blankets as linens are not provided. Club Yogi
